summary: Verified the diff for the WorkspaceInspector, registry, and tests changes (101 insertions, 60 deletions across 3 files). The change fixed routing so Unity runtime tabs (e.g., Console) stay in Unity while Subagents and Workflows render as workspace-level inspector tabs, with runtime ownership preserved in registry.svelte.ts.
decisions: Runtime tabs owned by Unity (e.g., Console) remain inside Unity, while Subagents and Workflows are exposed as workspace-level inspector tabs.
Runtime ownership for each tab is recorded in registry.svelte.ts so the active domain panel can distinguish workspace-owned vs runtime-owned tabs.
